resources.string: This build of the app has no Firebase settings, so orders can\'t be shared.

Give orders to masters who use PrintMaster too, or do orders other owners give you. Each company has its own code. Masters see only the orders given to them, with the client\'s phone, address and printers, never debts.
Work for %1$s in PrintMaster: open More → Masters & sharing → Enter a code, and type %2$s
No master has entered the code yet.
He gets no more orders of %1$s. Orders already on his phone stay there.
Last sync failed (no internet?). It will retry.
Sign-in didn\'t finish. Check the internet and try again.
The shared space couldn\'t be created. Check the internet and try again.
A new code couldn\'t be made. Check the internet and try again.
The code has 8 letters and digits
No company has this code. Check it, or ask for a new one.
Couldn\'t join. Check the internet and try again.
Sign in with your Google account to start. You need internet only this once; then the app works offline.
Backups go to your own Google Drive, so a lost phone doesn\'t lose your data.
Attach masters who use PrintMaster too, and give them orders.
Clients, debts and payments stay on your phone. Masters see only the orders you give them.
Make a code and send it to a master. When he enters it, he appears here and you can give him this company\'s orders.
None yet. When another owner sends you a code, enter it here: their company appears and their orders come to you.
The code another owner sent you. Their company will give you orders; you choose for each one whether it counts as yours.
Its new orders won\'t come to you. The orders you already did stay as history.
Orders %1$s gives you will appear in your Orders, marked with the company.
This is the code of your own company.
You already work for this company.
